g.title: fpga_data_pipeline
g.text: AERIS-10 - FPGA signal-processing pipeline as written in the RTL (hand-drawn from source)
Drawing ID: SD-02 Revision: A Date: 2026-10-09 Status: PARTIAL - the chain contains 5 instantiated-but-missing modules and several placeholders

Source: 9_Firmware/9_2_FPGA/radar_system_top.v, radar_receiver_final.v, radar_transmitter.v, ddc_400m.v, usb_data_interface.v, lvds_to_cmos_400m.v, matched_filter_multi_segment.v, doppler_processor.v; 9_Firmware/9_2_FPGA/reconstructed/PIN_MAP_FROM_SCHEMATIC.md
Every box names its instance and file:line; the clock domain shown is the one the RTL connects, not a verified timing closure.

g.title: legend
g.text: blue box = module defined in repo and instantiated (file:line = instantiation site)
orange box = defined but contains a documented defect or source-commented placeholder
red dashed box = instantiated but NO definition in repository (MISSING)
grey dotted box = defined but never instantiated (orphan)
red dashed edge = data path through a missing module; red dotted edge = no hardware path

Missing definitions: ad9484_lvds_to_cmos_400m (rrf:82), matched_filter_processing_chain (mfms:361), range_bin_decimator (rrf:226), xfft_32 (dp:283), FFT_enhanced (fft_1024_forward.v:102, fft_1024_inverse.v:78)
Undriven control: radar_receiver_final.v:21-25 (declared, never assigned), :204-208 (mc_new_* implicit wires)
Clock defect: lvds_to_cmos_400m.v:35-43; 400 MHz capture via IDDR exists only in the unused ad9484_interface_400m.v:46-60
NOT VERIFIED: timing closure, bit widths beyond declarations, functional correctness of any stage (no simulation run)
